title: South Korea's science ministry counts 2,587 cyber intrusion incidents through October, up 31.4% on a year earlier, inews24 reports
date_note: inews24 published the figures on 23 November from a ministry document submitted to the National Assembly; the page gives no date for the document.
org: Ministry of Science and ICT (South Korea)
geo_basis: country: a national ministry's count for South Korea
summary: Inews24 reports that a Ministry of Science and ICT document submitted to the National Assembly counts 2,587 cyber intrusion incidents in South Korea through October this year. That is 618 (31.4%) more than in the same period last year, according to the document as reported by inews24. The ministry document itself was not read.
plain: South Korea's science ministry recorded 2,587 hacking incidents through October, 31.4% more than a year earlier, according to a ministry document reported by the news site inews24.
exec: Reported intrusions in South Korea are up 31.4% year on year, per a ministry document reported by inews24.

validation.note: Only inews24's exclusive, which relays the Ministry of Science and ICT's document 'AI 시대, 해킹동향 및 대응방향' submitted to the National Assembly, was read; the document itself was not found or read.

review.note: Compared 2,587 and 31.4% figures, evidence quotes, MSIT document attribution and date against inews24; single_source correct
